scope.research_question: Can genuinely side-specific CAPM and FF5-plus-momentum short-alpha selectors identify the negative-alpha tail better than reversing the corresponding frozen long-alpha selector?

short_capm_alpha.construction: Within each month, rank max(-CAPM alpha, 0). Positive or zero alpha observations tie at zero; increasingly negative alpha receives increasingly high short-opportunity rank.

short_ff5_alpha.construction: Within each month, rank max(-FF5-plus-momentum alpha, 0). Positive or zero alpha observations tie at zero; increasingly negative alpha receives increasingly high short-opportunity rank.

search.ensembles: Reuse every prespecified V6.1 equal and causal dynamic ensemble; direct CAM is oriented toward negative alpha.
search.operating_schedule: For each alpha definition, reuse its frozen V6.1 refit, history, and retune schedules so the experiment isolates side specialization.

selection.primary_metric: equal-month mean cross-sectional Spearman rank IC against the downside-specific short-alpha target
selection.challenger_rule: Choose the highest validation mean IC among all new components and prespecified ensembles; break an exact tie by model_id.

checkpointing.identity_mismatch: fail closed into a new V6.5 output lineage
